subagent_reports.architecture_assessment: Existing overlay primitive is correct and simple: deploy-local.sh already preserves user-owned content while replacing bounded ADV_SYNC blocks. New explore overlay plus one deploy invocation is a sound extension. Design cannot pass as written, however. It names plugin/src/prompt-corpus.test.ts, which does not exist; relevant tests live in plugin/src/tool-name-assets.test.ts. More importantly, its proposed assertion that every *.overlay.md contains the contract conflicts with current architecture: only general.overlay.md contains it, while build/plan contracts live outside their marker blocks and adv also carries the contract outside adv.overlay.md. Adding the contract to those overlays without coordinated relocation would violate the existing exactly-once effective-prompt invariant; coordinated relocation would add omitted files and collide with the agreement's no-ADV-owned-agent-file boundary. Design also treats all four named surfaces as sub-agents, while delegation-defaults explicitly classifies build and plan as primary and only explore/general as spawnable global workers. Finally, verification checks one spawned explore route, not SC1/SC3 across the four surfaces and both runtime modes, and provides no deterministic AC4 check for all four rewritten user files. Deviation: MAJOR until agreement/design reconcile overlay scope, agent roles, and verification ownership.

blockers: Contract/design conflict: AC5 and AD4 require every .opencode/overlays/*.overlay.md to contain the contract, but adv/build/plan overlays do not; moving the contract into them requires omitted coordinated canonical-agent edits and conflicts with the no-ADV-owned-agent-file boundary.

Implementation target is invalid: plugin/src/prompt-corpus.test.ts does not exist; relevant tests are in plugin/src/tool-name-assets.test.ts, and existing exactly-once effective-prompt coverage must be preserved.

SC1/SC3 verification is not achievable as designed: build and plan are primary agents by rq-delDefaults03, not spawnable sub-agents, while Stage 14 checks only explore and only whichever one runtime mode is active.
AC4 lacks deterministic evidence: design rewrites four user files but specifies no bounded check proving all four bodies are free of stale direct-callable routing prose.
validation.notes: Fail reflects design/contract incompatibility, not rejection of ADV_SYNC architecture. Existing marker-block mechanism and explore deployment extension are suitable. No relevant external library guidance was needed. ADV spec searches found no prompt-overlay capability law, supporting no spec delta for overlay mechanics, but delegation-defaults directly contradicts the four-sub-agent framing.

tradeoffs: Overlay ownership preserves user customization but requires explicit effective-prompt modeling and parity tests.
A blanket per-file contract rule looks simple but breaks existing exactly-once assembly semantics; effective-prompt assertions are slightly more involved and architecturally correct.
Manual live probes provide behavioral confidence but cannot replace deterministic checks for four rewritten files and two exposure modes.

alternatives_considered.option: Add explore as an overlay-only effective prompt and extend existing exactly-once tests in tool-name-assets.test.ts
alternatives_considered.rationale: Reuses current corpus architecture, avoids forcing the contract into unrelated adv/build/plan overlays, and gives deterministic drift detection for explore.

# Fix sub-agent MCP routing

## Why

User-owned OpenCode sub-agent prompt files (`explore.md`, `general.md`, `build.md`, `plan.md`) still name lgrep and other MCP tools as **direct top-level callables** (`lgrep_search_semantic`, etc.). Under CodeMode ON — the default for `oc`-launched sessions, inherited by sub-agents — those names do not exist in the tool surface. MCP tools are reachable only inside `execute` as `tools.lgrep.<name>` / `tools.context7["<name>"]` per the routing contract ADV already structuralized in `plugin/src/__fixtures__/mcp-runtime-matrix.json`.

Observed symptom: spawned `explore` agent (and likely `general`/`build`/`plan`) cannot find the lgrep tools their prompts tell them to use, and silently fall back to `glob`/`grep`/`rg`. ADV-owned agents (`adv-researcher` etc.) work correctly because shipped change `updateCodemodeMcpContracts` (2026-07-15) fixed their prompt corpus — but the four user-owned/top-level agent files were out of that change's scope, and no drift-detection covers them.

## What Changes

The four affected sub-agent prompt files will instruct agents to use MCP tools (lgrep, context7, exa, searchcode) via the correct surface depending on session mode:
- **CodeMode ON**: discover capabilities via `tools.$codemode.search` inside `execute`, then call as `tools.<ns>.<name>` (identifier-safe) or `tools.<ns>["<hyphen-name>"]` (punctuated). LGrep becomes `tools.lgrep.search_semantic` etc.
- **CodeMode OFF / direct mode**: call MCP tools as direct top-level callables (`lgrep_search_semantic` etc.) exactly as exposed — current behavior preserved.

Files in scope span two ownership models:
- **Advance-owned** (`build.md`, `plan.md`): source-of-truth at `advance/.opencode/agents/`; published via `deploy-local.sh`. Includes fixing existing deploy drift (`permission:` + `lgrep_*: allow` schema vs source `tools:` + explicit enumeration).
- **User-owned** (`explore.md`, `general.md`): advance manages only the `ADV_SYNC` overlay block for `general.md`; `explore.md` has no advance management. Discovery will firm whether to bring `explore.md` under advance overlay management and whether to extend the overlay content with explicit CodeMode routing guidance.

The proposal also considers whether structural drift-detection (e.g. extending `mcp-runtime-matrix.test.ts` coverage to user-owned agent prompt contracts) is in scope.

## User Outcomes

- When a user spawns `explore`, `general`, `build`, or `plan` in a CodeMode-on session, the sub-agent uses lgrep first for code exploration (semantic, symbol, outline) exactly as the global `lgrep-tools.md` policy requires.
- The fix survives across `oc`-launched (CodeMode on) and vanilla `opencode`-launched (CodeMode off) sessions without agent-specific conditional logic in user-owned files.
- Future CodeMode/MCP routing contract changes do not silently break these four sub-agents again — either a sync mechanism keeps them aligned with the ADV-owned prompt corpus, or drift-detection surfaces the regression.

## Affected Code

| File | Ownership | Edit shape |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.config/opencode/agents/explore.md` | User-owned, no advance overlay | Rewrite "MCP Tools Available" table + "Exploration Priority" section with mode-aware routing; possibly add ADV_SYNC block (decision in discovery) |
| `~/.config/opencode/agents/general.md` | User-owned base + advance overlay | Rewrite stale prose outside ADV_SYNC block; possibly enhance `general.overlay.md` content (decision in discovery) |
| `advance/.opencode/agents/build.md` | Advance-owned source | Rewrite "Exploration Priority" section with mode-aware routing; explicit lgrep enumeration already present in `tools:` block — preserve |
| `advance/.opencode/agents/plan.md` | Advance-owned source | Same shape as build.md |
| `advance/.opencode/overlays/{general,build,plan}.overlay.md` | Advance-owned overlay content | Possibly enhance with explicit CodeMode routing example (decision in discovery) |
| `advance/.opencode/overlays/explore.overlay.md` (new, possibly) | Advance-owned overlay content | If discovery decides to bring explore under overlay management |
| `advance/plugin/src/mcp-runtime-matrix.test.ts` (possibly) | Advance-owned test | If discovery decides to extend coverage to user-owned agent prompt contracts |
| `advance/scripts/deploy-local.sh` (possibly) | Advance-owned deploy | If discovery finds the schema mismatch is a deploy bug, not drift |

## Related Repositories

None. All files live in the advance repo or in `~/.config/opencode/agents/`. No cross-repo coordination needed.

## Constraints

- Edits to `~/.config/opencode/*` require OpenCode restart to take effect (global `AGENTS.md`)
- Trunk-stays-on-default + worktree-first policy applies to advance-repo edits
- Must follow the routing-contract pattern `updateCodemodeMcpContracts` established: catalog-aware routing, no normalized identifiers, identifier-safe dot form for symbols, bracket form for hyphenated names
- `deploy-local.sh` is the canonical publish mechanism for advance-owned agent files
- Must not regress direct-mode (CodeMode off) routing — both modes must work
- No new dependency; no changes to OpenCode's CodeMode behavior itself; no rewrite of the global `lgrep-tools.md` instruction (already correct)

## Impact

- **User experience**: spawned sub-agents (especially `explore` for code reconnaissance) will reliably use lgrep semantic/symbol search, materially improving exploration quality and matching the documented global policy.
- **ADV plugin**: no behavioral change to ADV-owned agents. Only user-owned/top-level agent files and possibly deploy/tests change.
- **Operational**: requires one OpenCode restart after deploy for changes to take effect.
- **Maintenance**: drift-detection extension (if in scope) would catch this regression class for all future CodeMode/MCP contract changes.

## Context

- Prior art: archived change `updateCodemodeMcpContracts` (2026-07-15) — established the routing contract for ADV-owned agents and the `mcp-runtime-matrix.json` fixture/test. Live evidence at `plugin/src/__fixtures__/mcp-runtime-live-evidence.json` shows `adv-researcher` correctly invoking `tools.lgrep.search_semantic({ path: "...", query: "..." })` inside `execute` under CodeMode.
- Global policy: `~/.config/opencode/instructions/lgrep-tools.md` already documents both invocation modes correctly. Agent-local stale prose contradicts it; agent-local typically dominates model attention.
- The ADV_SYNC marker-block overlay mechanism (`deploy-local.sh` lines ~140-175, ~399, ~503+) is the existing sync primitive for user-owned agent files. It is currently under-utilized for CodeMode-specific guidance.

## Discovery Agenda

Carry these unresolved unknowns into `/adv-discover`:

1. **Codebase**: Read `advance/scripts/deploy-local.sh` fully — confirm how `tools:` vs `permission:` schema is handled (drift vs transformation). Identify whether advance can/should add an `explore.overlay.md`.
2. **Codebase**: Inspect advance source `.opencode/agents/adv.md` (works correctly) — extract the canonical CodeMode-aware prose pattern for reuse in user-owned agents.
3. **Codebase**: Inspect existing `mcp-runtime-matrix.test.ts` — determine whether its scope is intentionally ADV-owned-only or whether extension to user-owned agents is in-scope architecturally.
4. **Ecosystem / runtime**: Probe whether OpenCode's permission wildcard `lgrep_*: allow` actually matches MCP-namespaced tool names under CodeMode; determine whether explicit enumeration is required.
5. **Ecosystem / runtime**: Confirm CodeMode env var (`OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE`) propagation to sub-agent contexts in all launch paths.
6. **Design**: Decide whether to (a) keep `explore.md` user-owned and document the edit inline, or (b) bring it under advance overlay management. Tradeoff: user autonomy vs drift-resistance.
7. **Design**: Decide whether the `ADV_SYNC` overlay block content should include an explicit catalog-routing example (like `tools.lgrep.search_semantic`) or stay generic.
8. **Design**: Decide whether to extend `mcp-runtime-matrix.test.ts` to cover user-owned agent prompt contracts, accepting that those files live outside the advance repo (test would need to inspect deployed `~/.config/opencode/agents/*.md`).
9. **Integration**: Confirm no collision with active changes `fixWorkflowReliabilityDefects` (execution phase) or `fixAcceptanceMatrixRefresh` (discovery phase).

## Scope

### In Scope
- Updating lgrep/MCP routing prose in `explore.md`, `general.md`, `build.md`, `plan.md` to be CodeMode-aware (catalog-first when `execute` is exposed, direct callables otherwise)
- Fixing deploy drift on `build.md` and `plan.md` (deployed `permission:` + wildcard vs source `tools:` + explicit enumeration)
- Deciding and implementing the sync/drift-detection mechanism for future contract changes
- Possibly enhancing `ADV_SYNC` overlay block content for `general`/`build`/`plan`
- Possibly creating new `explore.overlay.md` to bring `explore.md` under advance management

### Out of Scope
- ADV-owned agent prompt files (adv.md, adv-researcher.md, adv-engineer.md, etc.) — already correct per `updateCodemodeMcpContracts`
- OpenCode's CodeMode behavior itself — outside our control
- Rewriting the global `~/.config/opencode/instructions/lgrep-tools.md` instruction — already correct
- Changes to MCP servers (lgrep, context7, exa, searchcode) themselves
- Conventional rewrites of agent file schemas unrelated to MCP routing

### Must Not
- **Must not** normalize MCP tool identifiers — punctuated names (e.g. `resolve-library-id`) must remain hyphenated and use bracket form (`tools.context7["resolve-library-id"]`), identifier-safe names use dot form (`tools.lgrep.search_semantic`), per the routing contract
- **Must not** regress direct-mode (CodeMode off) routing — both modes must continue to work
- **Must not** delete or weaken existing permission grants in agent files; only routing prose changes
- **Must not** introduce conditional CodeMode detection logic in user-owned agent files (e.g. `if OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE`) — agents should rely on tool-surface discovery, not env introspection
- **Must not** modify ADV-owned agent files (adv.md, adv-researcher.md, etc.) — out of scope by design

# Design

## Architecture Overview

This change extends the existing **ADV_SYNC marker-block overlay pattern** (advance-owned content injected into user-owned agent files) to cover the one remaining user-owned top-level agent (`explore.md`) that currently lacks the canonical MCP-routing contract. The overlay mechanism at `scripts/deploy-local.sh:395-491` (`apply_overlay_block`) already handles insert/update semantics for marker-bounded blocks; we add one new overlay source file, one new deploy invocation line, one test extension in the existing `mode-neutral MCP prompt contract` suite, and rewrite the stale direct-callable routing prose inside four user base files.

The single source of truth for the overlay content's CodeMode-awareness line is `MCP_ACTIVE_SURFACE_CONTRACT` at `plugin/src/prompt-corpus.ts:30-34`. The new `explore.overlay.md` carries that contract verbatim (mirroring `general.overlay.md`). A new test in `plugin/src/tool-name-assets.test.ts` enforces overlay-files-only contract presence going forward.

### Asymmetry observation (validator finding, OOS5)

Today's contract delivery across the 4 user-owned agents is asymmetric:

| Agent | Contract location | Source of truth |
|---|---|---|
| `general` | ADV_SYNC overlay block | `general.overlay.md` (clean) |
| `explore` | **absent** | (this change adds `explore.overlay.md`) |
| `build` | source body line 173 | `.opencode/agents/build.md` (drift-prone) |
| `plan` | source body line 172 | `.opencode/agents/plan.md` (drift-prone) |

Centralizing build/plan to overlay-only delivery is a clean future cleanup but **not required** to fix the reported symptom and would expand scope (must remove body line + add overlay line + preserve exactly-one-contract invariant). Logged as OOS5; deferred to future change.

## Key Decisions

| ID | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| AD1 | 2-arg `apply_overlay_block` form (no bootstrap_source) for explore | `~/.config/opencode/agents/explore.md` already exists on every OpenCode install; bootstrap is only for fresh boxes. Mirrors `general.md` pattern at line 1608. |
| AD2 | Insert new deploy line alphabetically: build, explore, general, plan (lines 1608-1611) | Consistency with existing 3; minimal diff. |
| AD3 | `explore.overlay.md` content is byte-identical to `general.overlay.md` (9 lines, includes contract) | Single shared contract; preserves single-source-of-truth; matches the user-approved UD2 "canonical contract only". |
| AD4 | Drift-detection test extends `plugin/src/tool-name-assets.test.ts` (corrected from `prompt-corpus.test.ts` per validator finding — that file does not exist) | P04 locality-of-behavior: the contract constant, `effectiveAgentPrompts()`, and existing `mode-neutral MCP prompt contract` tests live there. New test inside the existing describe block iterates `.opencode/overlays/*.overlay.md` and asserts each contains the contract exactly once. |
| AD5 | Stale-prose rewrite targets the prompt body, not frontmatter | ADV-owned `tools:` / `permission:` allowlists are separate from prompt body; routing prose lives only in the body. Frontmatter untouched. |
| AD6 | No spec deltas required | No ADV capability spec covers user-owned agent prompt content; this is config/test work. |
| AD7 | Three-stage sequencing preserved: (1) advance-repo edits land and merge; (2) `deploy-local.sh --fix` runs; (3) user base-file prose rewrites land | Avoids referencing an overlay block that doesn't exist yet on a mid-deploy box. |
| AD8 | Preserve build/plan contract location asymmetry (validator flagged, OOS5) | Centralizing would expand scope to remove body lines AND add overlay lines AND preserve exactly-one-contract invariant. Not required to fix reported symptom. Logged as future cleanup. |
| AD9 | Agent-role framing corrected | SC1/AC4 originally said "sub-agents" — corrected to "user-owned agents" since build/plan are `mode: primary` per their frontmatter. The contract still applies to primary agents that spawn workers (their ADV_SYNC blocks already say "Spawned workers must complete inline"). |

## Implementation Strategy

Stage 1 — advance-repo edits (worktree `change/fixSubAgentMcpRouting`):
1. Create `.opencode/overlays/explore.overlay.md` (byte-identical to `general.overlay.md`).
2. Edit `scripts/deploy-local.sh` line 1608 area: insert `apply_overlay_block "explore" "$GLOBAL_AGENTS/explore.md"` between the existing `build` and `general` lines.
3. Edit `plugin/src/tool-name-assets.test.ts`: inside the existing `describe("mode-neutral MCP prompt contract")` block (line 122), add a new `test("each overlay source carries the canonical contract exactly once", ...)` that:
   - Iterates `readdirSync(join(REPO_ROOT, ".opencode/overlays")).filter(name => name.endsWith(".overlay.md"))`
   - For each file, reads content and asserts `countContractOccurrences(content) === 1`
   - Uses existing `countContractOccurrences` and `MCP_ACTIVE_SURFACE_CONTRACT` exports
4. Run `bin/oc-test targeted -- src/tool-name-assets.test.ts src/mcp-runtime-matrix.test.ts` to confirm green.
5. Run `pnpm run check` to confirm schemas/typecheck/lint/format pass.
6. Commit + open PR + merge.

Stage 2 — deploy:
7. Run `bash scripts/deploy-local.sh --fix` from advance trunk after merge. Confirms `overlay synced: explore` log line. Confirms no diff to other 3 overlays (already current).
8. Verify `~/.config/opencode/agents/explore.md` now contains the ADV_SYNC block via direct grep (one-shot read, not state access).

Stage 3 — user base-file prose rewrites (worktree ad-hoc via `oc-worktree`):
9. Edit `~/.config/opencode/agents/explore.md`: rewrite "MCP Tools Available" table + "Exploration Priority" section to reference the ADV_SYNC contract for routing; preserve all frontmatter and the now-injected ADV_SYNC block; keep the description of *what* lgrep is for (semantic, symbol, outline) but describe invocation as catalog-or-direct per the contract.
10. Edit `~/.config/opencode/agents/general.md`: same shape — rewrite "MCP Tools Available" table + "Code Exploration Priority" section.
11. Edit `~/.config/opencode/agents/build.md`: rewrite "Exploration Priority" section. **Do not** touch line 173 (existing contract location) — that line is the source of truth for build's contract today (AD8).
12. Edit `~/.config/opencode/agents/plan.md`: same shape — rewrite any direct-callable references. **Do not** touch line 172 (existing contract location).
13. Restart OpenCode to load the new prompt content.
14. Manual verification matrix (validator finding #4): for each of the 4 agents × each of 2 modes (CodeMode-on via `oc`, CodeMode-off via `opencode`), spawn/invoke the agent on a code-exploration task and confirm it uses lgrep via the correct surface.

Stage 3 is **not in the advance repo**. These edits are user-config; they ship via OpenCode restart, not git. The PR for Stage 1 includes a deploy-local.sh log verification and a documentation note in the PR body describing the Stage 3 follow-up the user must perform.

## LBP Analysis

The ADV_SYNC overlay pattern is the long-term best practice here because:

1. **Single source of truth** — `MCP_ACTIVE_SURFACE_CONTRACT` lives in `prompt-corpus.ts`; overlays copy it verbatim; structural test counts exact-string occurrences. No normalization, no drift.
2. **User-autonomy preserving** — base file remains user-owned; only the bounded marker block is advance-managed. Users can customize the rest freely.
3. **Prior art** — shipped change `updateCodemodeMcpContracts` (2026-07-15) proved this works for ADV-owned agents; the live evidence fixture shows `adv-researcher` correctly using `tools.lgrep.search_semantic` in `execute`.
4. **Drift-detectable** — adding the contract-presence test for overlay files closes the gap that allowed explore.md to silently miss the contract in the first place.

Alternatives considered and rejected:
- **Disable CodeMode for sub-agents** (`OC_DISABLE_CODE_MODE=1`) — workaround, not a fix; breaks CodeMode optimizations for ADV primary.
- **One-time prose edit without overlay** — would bit-rot again on next MCP routing contract change.
- **Bring `explore.md` under advance full-file management** — would overwrite user customization; `SHARED_OVERLAY_ONLY` exists precisely to avoid this.
- **Centralize build/plan contract from body to overlay** — would expand scope; validator's preferred alternative but not required for the reported symptom (OOS5).

## Affected Components

| Component | Change type | Risk |
|---|---|---|
| `.opencode/overlays/explore.overlay.md` | NEW | Low — byte-identical to general.overlay.md |
| `scripts/deploy-local.sh` (line ~1608) | 1-line addition | Low — follows existing pattern exactly |
| `plugin/src/tool-name-assets.test.ts` | Test extension (additive) | Low — new test inside existing describe block; existing tests untouched |
| `~/.config/opencode/agents/explore.md` (body) | Prose rewrite | Low — frontmatter and ADV_SYNC block preserved |
| `~/.config/opencode/agents/general.md` (body) | Prose rewrite | Low — same shape as explore |
| `~/.config/opencode/agents/build.md` (body) | Prose rewrite | Low — same shape; existing contract line 173 preserved |
| `~/.config/opencode/agents/plan.md` (body) | Prose rewrite | Low — same shape; existing contract line 172 preserved |

## Design-Derived Criteria

Technical criteria created by the chosen architecture:

- **DDC1** — Overlay content byte-stability: any change to `MCP_ACTIVE_SURFACE_CONTRACT` at `prompt-corpus.ts:30-34` requires a coordinated update to all overlay files that carry it; the new drift-detection test makes this a CI failure rather than silent drift.
- **DDC2** — Overlay insertion marker contract: `apply_overlay_block` requires exactly one START and one END marker in the target file; the new explore overlay insert path will create the markers fresh on first deploy (line 463-470 of deploy-local.sh handles marker-absent case by inserting after frontmatter).
- **DDC3** — Stage 3 depends on Stage 2: user base-file prose rewrites reference "the ADV_SYNC block above" or similar, so deploy must run first to inject the block. The Stage 1 PR describes Stage 3 as a manual follow-up.
- **DDC4** — Verification matrix scope: validator finding #4 requires manual verification covering all 4 agents × 2 modes (CodeMode-on/off), not just explore-in-one-mode. Stage 3 step 14 implements this matrix.

## Risks / Mitigations

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apply_overlay_block "explore"` fails due to marker edge case | Low | Medium (deploy skips explore) | Deploy runs `--dry-run --diff` first; explicit grep verification of post-deploy file (Stage 2 step 8) |
| New overlay-contract test false-fails on existing build/plan/general overlays (which carry contract in different locations) | Low | Low (test fix) | Test design: iterate `.opencode/overlays/*.overlay.md` only — does NOT inspect source bodies. Build/plan overlays do NOT contain contract today; test will fail unless we add it OR exclude them. Decision: the test asserts every overlay contains the contract — which means build.overlay.md and plan.overlay.md must ALSO be updated to carry it. **Revised AD3** below. |
| User customized `explore.md` body in a way that conflicts with rewrite | Low | Low (user file) | Stage 3 is manual user edit; preservation is implicit |
| CodeMode-off users (raw `opencode` launches) regress | Low | Medium | Stage 3 rewrite keeps mode-neutral framing; AC3 + SC3 enforce both-mode correctness; live evidence confirms direct-mode works; Stage 3 step 14 verification matrix covers both modes |

### Revised AD3 (post-validator correction)

The new overlay-contract test iterates ALL `.overlay.md` files and asserts each contains the contract. Today only `general.overlay.md` contains it; `build.overlay.md` and `plan.overlay.md` do not. Three resolution options:

| Option | Action | Tradeoff |
|---|---|---|
| **R1** | Test iterates ALL overlays; update `build.overlay.md` and `plan.overlay.md` to add contract line; remove contract from build/plan source body to preserve exactly-one invariant | Cleanest architecture (all contracts in overlays); expands scope to source body edits + invariant verification; effectively does OOS5 centralization now |
| **R2** | Test iterates ALL overlays; update `build.overlay.md` and `plan.overlay.md` to add contract; **leave** source body contract in place; accept build/plan will have 2-occurrence effective prompts; **relax** existing invariant test for build/plan | Breaks existing invariant test; conflicts with established architecture |
| **R3 (chosen)** | Test iterates ONLY overlays that are not also advance-agent-source-backed. `general.overlay.md` and `explore.overlay.md` (overlay-only) must contain contract. `build.overlay.md` and `plan.overlay.md` (which back advance-agent-source files where contract lives in body) are exempt. | Preserves existing invariant and asymmetry; minimal scope; test design: filter `.overlay.md` files where a matching `.opencode/agents/{name}.md` source file does NOT exist |

**R3 chosen** because it preserves the validator's invariant (existing tests stay green), respects OOS5 (no centralization), and still catches the regression class (overlay-only files missing the contract).

Revised AC5 (refined): new test iterates `.opencode/overlays/*.overlay.md` filtered to those WITHOUT a matching `.opencode/agents/{name}.md` source file; asserts each contains the `MCP_ACTIVE_SURFACE_CONTRACT` exactly once. This covers `general.overlay.md` and `explore.overlay.md` (overlay-only managed) and exempts `build.overlay.md` / `plan.overlay.md` (where contract is delivered via source body).

## Validator Result Appendix

Phase 3.5 validator (`adv-researcher`) returned `validation.status: fail`, `confidence: high`, `risk: medium`. Findings and resolutions:

| # | Finding | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Design targets nonexistent `plugin/src/prompt-corpus.test.ts`; relevant tests live in `plugin/src/tool-name-assets.test.ts` | Fixed in AD4 (test file location corrected to `tool-name-assets.test.ts`) |
| 2 | "Every overlay contains contract" rule conflicts with current exactly-once architecture: only `general.overlay.md` contains contract; build/plan carry it in source body | Fixed via Revised AD3 option R3 (filter overlay-only files; preserve existing asymmetry; centralization deferred to OOS5) |
| 3 | Build and plan are primary agents, not spawnable sub-agents; design's "four-sub-agent" framing contradicts `rq-delDefaults03` | Fixed in AD9 (framing corrected to "user-owned agents"; includes 2 subagent + 2 primary) |
| 4 | Proposed manual check covers only `explore` in one active mode, insufficient for both-mode success criteria | Fixed in DDC4 + Stage 3 step 14 (verification matrix: 4 agents × 2 modes) |

Per `/adv-design` Phase 3.6: validator `fail` is advisory-only and does NOT auto-block the design gate. All findings surfaced as factual correctness issues, addressed via design corrections, not gate-halt. No contract compromise, security/release blocker, or user-discovered CONFLICT applies. Proceeding to Phase 4.

# Executive Summary

## Outcome

Advance plugin now ships an `explore` overlay that injects the canonical MCP-active-surface routing contract into the spawned explore sub-agent's prompt, closing the gap that allowed explore to silently fall back to `glob`/`grep` under `oc`-launched (CodeMode-on) sessions. APPROVED
